name: Kurd (Hungary)
description: White field charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Kurd (a red, blue and green shield with ears of grain, a bunch of grapes, a wavy stripe and a black wolf, bordered in yellow) above the name KURD in black.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.
